simple: A cloud SIEM with an AI assistant and traps for attackers. Collects logs from computers, sign-in systems, the cloud and SaaS services; detects threats using a rule library (formerly Attacker Behavior Analytics) and unusual user behavior (UEBA); AI filters out false alarms on its own and builds an investigation timeline; traps (fake servers, files, users and passwords) give away an attacker who is already inside. Includes automated response (SOAR), the advanced Intelligence Hub threat intelligence, asset inventory and monitoring of resources visible from the internet. The Rapid7 agent on computers provides ready-made detections of suspicious processes and PowerShell commands, Office macros, password theft from memory (Mimikatz, LSASS dump) and persistence in the system; it also alerts if user credentials show up in public leaks. Logs are retained for 180 days. Ransomware protection is available for an extra fee.
